claim_ceiling: Dense embeddings are NECESSARY and SUFFICIENT for two non-jurist-preference product views (Citation Heritage Recovery at >=130k scale; Section Cross-Lingual at full corpus pending extraction) and a Linear Hybrid Complement mode (PASS adversarial at >=122k, w=0.3-0.4, cross-lingual benefit +0.036 recall). TF-IDF citation hybrids remain PRIMARY for JuristPref (0.78). True OOS ceiling ~0.53. Data blockers prevent 174k completion. No further same-question cycles justified.
evidence_summary: Citation heritage dense superiority SUPPORTED (21yr/22yr/24yr AUC > 0.75 vs TF-IDF 0.71-0.74). Section cross-lingual hierarchy SUPPORTED at sample scale (Sachverhalt 0.282 > Dispositiv 0.150 > Erwaegungen 0.094 cp64). Linear hybrid complement SUPPORTED (PASS adversarial 19yr+, JP 0.61-0.67 < TF-IDF 0.78-0.79). Two-mode tradeoff SUPPORTED (6 scales, no single mode dominates). True OOS JP ceiling SUPPORTED (~0.53 < 0.7 target). Legal TF-IDF bge_ corpus NEGATIVE CONTROL PASSES (6-8/14 adversarial PASS, citation heritage AUC ~0.5). v18 coarse hierarchy NEGATIVE RESULT HONEST (best purity 0.65 < 0.7). v14 independent rerun MIXED HONESTLY REPORTED (linear_citation_concat REPRODUCED; linear_hybrid05_w3070 NOT reproduced). Data blockers UNRESOLVED HONESTLY DISCLOSED (bge_/bger_ mapping, parquet 2022-2026, section extraction). Orchestration failure DIAGNOSED NOT HIDDEN (2022-2023 embeddings EXIST + PASS quality check but flagged failed). All negative/null results properly elevated. No leakage, gaming, or confounding detected.
